correctness.rationale: The metric-shadow equivalence and five profile types were reconstructed. A four-subset incidence convexity proof excludes eight squarefree blocks and forces a Steiner triple system when seven occur. The directed-arc budget bounds the whole code by 35 and saturation forces the full 42-arc partition. Every 211 support must hit all Fano lines, hence be a Fano line; missing 22-pairs force two conflicting reverse-arc 211 words. This yields all 28 even words and exactly seven Fano complements. The 30 labeled STS(7) systems and each associated 35-profile code were directly computed by the included executable and checked through all pairs. No infinite conclusion relies on a finite test.

value.rationale: The q=7, degree-four multiset-deletion optimum is a natural isolated exceptional parameter in recent exact coding theory. Complete classification decides whether optimal codebooks admit exotic alternatives, establishes a 28-word universal core, gives the sole Fano-plane family and its 30 labeled forms, and converts an existence construction into a rigid design correspondence. These answers remain meaningful although the size 35 and one Fano construction are known.
